rust_summary: The client pause state changes (`native_client_pause_change_pre` and `native_client_pause_change_post`).
doc_summary: Before a client pause-state change, `native_client_pause_change_pre(paused, cancel)` may cancel it. After an accepted change, `native_client_pause_change_post(paused)` observes the updated state. Bundles need "hooks": @API:client_pause_change@.
